title: [SDUI][P2] Schema configurability for charts & alt list views
body:
## Context
Charts and the kanban/calendar/gantt/map views render but their runtime customization is limited — chart config is largely read-only, and the alt views rely on config carried in the legacy list-view model.

## Goal
Increase the schema-driven configurability of charts and the alternate list visualizations so they can be authored/edited consistently with the rest of SDUI.

## Scope
- Expose chart spec (type, axes, series, aggregation) as editable schema with a config panel.
- Ensure kanban/calendar/gantt/map options are first-class in the (new) list PageSchema.

## Acceptance
- [ ] Chart visualization is editable via a config panel and persists
- [ ] Alt list viewtypes carry their options in the schema, not ad-hoc config
